messages:
From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@medicosys.com>

Subject: SIG questionnaire — admin activity / audit logs (initial ask)

Hi Marcus,

We're kicking off the SIG questionnaire review and our security team has a handful of specific asks around admin activity / audit logging evidence. High level: our auditors need a short deliverable that demonstrates (1) what events you record for admin/operator activity, (2) sample extracts showing the fields and formats, (3) retention policy and snapshots for the last 12 months, and (4) exact export options (S3, CSV, JSON, scoped time ranges) including chain-of-custody notes.

Could you confirm if Redwood can provide: 1) a 48-hour sample extract with field definitions, 2) a short runbook describing the export steps and where the data lives, and 3) an official statement of retention for admin activity logs? We have a deadline for the SIG pack in two weeks.

Also copying Maya from procurement who will coordinate transfer details.

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Cho
Security Programs, MedicoSys

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-12T10:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — admin activity / audit logs (initial ask)

Hi Evan — thanks for the clear list. We can provide all three deliverables you outlined. Quick plan:

- Deliverable A: 48-hour sample extract (CSV + schema) focusing on admin actions (create/delete/role-change/privilege-escalation, plus request_id/trace_id).
- Deliverable B: Export runbook (PDF) with export steps, authentication, and allowed transfer methods (S3 presigned, SFTP, secure Drive link).
- Deliverable C: Retention statement (formal text + retention bounds and snapshot policy).

I'll coordinate internal steps and attach the sample + runbook tomorrow. For chain-of-custody we typically include an MD5 manifest and an audit-run metadata file; I'll include the manifest in the package.

Questions for clarity: do your auditors need raw syslog-level events, or filtered "admin activity" events (we can provide both but they differ in volume and PII)?

Timeline: sample package by EOD tomorrow (11/13), full retention statement and export playbook within three business days. If that timing works, I'll proceed.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Platform Security Integrations, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:08:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG questionnaire — admin activity / audit logs (initial ask)

Forwarding Evan's request — action items below. Evan asked for: 48-hour sample extract, export runbook, and retention statement. He also asked about chain-of-custody.

Quick proposals (please reply inline):
- Sample extract: provide a 48-hour window (UTC 2026-10-28T00:00 — 2026-10-29T23:59) as CSV and a compressed JSONL. Columns to include: timestamp, actor_email, actor_role, action, target_type, target_id, source_ip, request_id, trace_id, outcome, region, operator_notes. Add a separate column is_system_generated (true/false).
- Redaction: redact user IPs for internal-only fields if the customer requests; provide raw IPs only under NDA / SFTP with encryption.
- Manifest: add scoped_log_manifest.json with MD5 hash for each file, and a short handover.txt with export_time and operator identity.
- Export methods: S3 presigned PUT (preferred), SFTP, or secure Drive share. For presigned S3 we need a bucket name from them and an expiry window.
- Retention: we have a 13-month rolling retention for admin activity metadata by default; older snapshots are archived but require a retrieval job (72-hour lead time). Need a formal statement from compliance.

Can you assemble the CSV + JSONL generators and the playbook? Laura — can you drop the CSV schema and example? Neha — can you confirm the retention statement wording and chain-of-custody snippet we typically include?

Thanks,
Marcus

Marcus — attaching the sample manifest and a short export playbook draft. Per our discussion:

- CSV schema (example header): timestamp,actor_email,actor_role,action,target_type,target_id,source_ip,request_id,trace_id,outcome,is_system_generated,operator_notes

I recommend we *send the filtered CSV and the playbook* to Evan and offer the raw JSONL under SFTP if MedicoSys signs the transfer addendum.

I'll put the sample CSV and manifest in my outbox — Marcus, want me to attach to your external response or should I upload to the Drive folder and share?

—Laura

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cho <evan.cho@medicosys.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <m.patel@medicosys.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T15:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — admin activity / audit logs (package delivery)

Evan — attached is the package we discussed. Summary of deliverables included in this email thread:

1) admin_activity_sample.csv (CSV, filtered admin events, 48-hour window) — example header and a 50-row slice for schema verification.
2) scoped_log_manifest.json — manifest with MD5 hashes, export_time, and operator identity for chain-of-custody.
3) export_playbook_v1.pdf — step-by-step export instructions (S3 presigned, SFTP, Drive), recommended encryption, and validation steps to verify manifest integrity.

Retention statement (short): Redwood retains admin activity metadata for 13 months on a rolling basis. Archived snapshots older than 13 months are retained for an additional 24 months in cold storage and are retrievable via a data retrieval job (standard SLA: 72 business hours). We can produce a signed retention attestation if your legal/audit teams need a stamped document.

Notes / clarifications:
- We provided a filtered extract (admin-only) by default to reduce PII surface area. If your auditors require raw system logs or background job traces, we can provide JSONL raw exports under an SFTP transfer with an executed transfer addendum.
- Chain-of-custody: each exported file is accompanied by a manifest entry (filename, md5, export_time, operator_email). The MD5 values can be validated after download; we recommend transferring via S3 presigned PUT and verifying checksums post-transfer.

Attachments: admin_activity_sample.csv, scoped_log_manifest.json, export_playbook_v1.pdf (see attached).

Next steps: please confirm whether the filtered CSV is sufficient or if you want the raw JSONL. If raw, please confirm preferred transfer method (S3 bucket name for presigned PUT or SFTP endpoint) and we will generate presigned credentials with an expiry window.

Regards,
Marcus
Head of Platform Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
